decision_rules: Every extracted claim in evaluations-v332-canonical.json receives exactly one match decision.
concept_id is drawn only from that turn's gold allowed_question_concepts or allowed_revision_concepts, otherwise null with match_type unsupported.
exact and alias require claim text identical to the evidence span plus an ontology alias hit; no claim in this snapshot meets that bar, so all supported matches are semantic with confidence >= 0.8.
preserve-intended-recipient is never a required revision concept in v3.3; no claim was matched to it here.
No concept was invented and no claim was dropped; all 18 cases and 24 turns are represented.
